Chinese military study warns cities of nuclear attack, flags Japan

A study by China's People's Liberation Army (PLA) Rocket Force has advised Chinese cities to prepare for potential nuclear attacks. The report specifically identified Japan as a "major danger signal" to the world. The study's findings were published by The Times of India.
